distance: Distance in meters of the nearest CORS station from a given location
ellipHeight: Height, in meters, above the geometric reference frame ellipsoid
epoch: The date, in decimal years, CE, for the coordinates; important if the mark is moving within the reference frame
lat: Latitude, in decimal degrees, positive north of the equator
latDms: Latitude in Degrees-Minutes-Seconds with a 'N'orth or 'S'outh hemisphere prefix
lon: Longitude in decimal degrees; negative west of the prime meridian
lonDms: Longitude in Degrees-Minutes-Seconds with an 'E'ast or 'W'est hemisphere prefix
name: A human-friendly mark identifier associated with a mark, may not be unique
netCorrNE: Correlation coefficient between latitude and longitude
pacsSacs: Primary Airport Control Station(PACS) or Secondary Control Airport Station(SACS) indicator
pid: A 6-character permanent identifier that uniquely identifies a mark
posOrder: A code that identifies the order of Horizontal Position
refFrame: Datum for latitude, longitude, and ellipsoid height
satUse: Y=The location is suitable for satellite visibility
setting: The mark's underlying structure, e.g., a concrete post or deep-driven rod
spcCombinedFactor: A product of scale factor and elevation factor that varies by latitude and ellipsoid height
spcConvergence: Angular difference between grid north and geodetic north, in Degrees-Minutes-Seconds
spcEasting: East coordinate of State Plane in meters
spcNorthing: North coordinate of State Plane in meters
spcZone: Name of a State Plane Coordinate zone
stCounty: State abbreviation and County name where a mark is located
stability: An estimate of the mark's ability to maintain a long-term, constant position relative to other local features
stamping: A transcription of the name and/or other characters, if any, struck into the mark's tablet
utmCombinedFactor: A product of UTM scale factor and elevation factor that varies by latitude and ellipsoid height
utmConvergence: Angular difference between grid north and geodetic north, in Degrees-Minutes-Seconds
utmEasting: East coordinate of UTM in meters
utmNorthing: North coordinate of UTM in meters
utmZone: Name of a Universal Transverse Mercator(UTM)zone
